133383.overview: In this game you control a chicken who must run around the farm collecting her eggs and putting them back in the coop. Trying to stop you are various predators such as snakes, birds and a cunning fox. You also have to be careful not to smash the eggs as you push them back to safety. If you take too long the eggs hatch into chicks and these little death merchants are much more difficult to catch! Once you collect all the eggs/chicks it's game over.

139864.overview: Opcode Games and Konami put the fight back into your ColecoVision game system with Yie Ar Kung-Fu. In this spin-off of the exciting and innovative arcade game, you'll battle your way to the top of a mysterious palace filled with the world's most dangerous warriors. Can you withstand the might of the Chop Suey Triad Gang and save China from the diabolical Willy Wu? Whatever happens, you'll agree that your ColecoVision has never seen a fight this furious!

182819.overview:
Your sister is a paranormal investigator who went to visit a renowned ghost house. She has disappeared in this manor full of monsters. You’ve decided to go there to rescue her. As you explore this Monster House, you pick up all the things she has lost along the way: shoes, flashlight, cameras and all her ghost-hunting equipment.

Your flashlight is your only means of fighting the supernatural horrors that inhabit here, so you’d better keep it stocked with fresh batteries.

This game was converted from the MSX version.

183143.overview:
It was just twenty years ago that LEE, the Kung Fu Master, wiped out the dastardly Chop Suey Gang. But one member of the gang managed to survive... YEN PEI now calls himself the Yie Gah Emperor, and with his seven warlords, he has extended his evil influence throughout China.

LEE's son, LEE YOUNG, has come forth to meet this evil emperor. To the deadly killing arts of Kung Fu which he learned from his father, he has added his own special techniques. Help LEE YOUNG to use his Kung Fu against the Yie Gah Emperor!!

For use with ONE or TWO players

456810.overview:
Place arrows to change the direction of your car and pass all the flags to clear the level.
If your car goes off screen or hits a rock, you fail.
If the car hits a wall it will flip but the wall will disappear.
